meta.title: 金三银四别乱跳槽｜三个问题定去留
meta.title_en: Don't Job-Hop Mindlessly: Ask These Three Questions First

scenes.context: 讲者指出金三银四也不是跳槽的万能时机，有人被劝退是因为跳槽时机不对。
sentences: 到了招聘求职的金三银四，有不少小伙伴想抓住机会找到好工作。
During the golden recruitment season, a lot of people want to seize the chance to land a good job.
金三银四：the golden recruitment season
有些找我做求职辅导的小伙伴，居然被我劝退了找工作的念头。
Some job seekers I coach actually got talked out of job-hunting.
被劝退：got talked out of
因为他们跳槽的实际不对。
Because the timing of their job-hop wasn't right.
跳槽时机：the timing of a job-hop
paraphrase: 金三银四 ≠ 人人该跳
The peak season isn't a green light for everyone to leave.
Ask about timing before you talk about leaving.
scenes.speak: During the golden recruitment season, a lot of people want to seize the chance to land a good job. Some job seekers I coach actually got talked out of job-hunting. Because the timing of their job-hop wasn't right.

scenes.title_en: Question One: Is Your Reason Rational?
scenes.context: 讲者给出第一个问题：跳槽原因要拨开表象，感性跳槽等于逃避现实。
sentences: 一定要拨开表象去看问题的本质。
You have to look past the surface to the root of the problem.
拨开表象：look past the surface
觉得领导无能或者团队关系紧张就想跳槽，这其实是感性的。
Wanting to leave because you think your boss is useless or the team is tense—that's emotional.
感性的：emotional
感性跳槽其实是在逃避现实，没有从根本上解决问题。
Emotional job-hopping is running away from reality, not solving the root problem.
逃避现实：run away from reality
paraphrase: 情绪化理由 → 问题跟着走
Emotional reasons follow you to the next company.
跳槽前先分清理性与感性
Sort rational from emotional reasons before jumping.
scenes.speak: You have to look past the surface to the root of the problem. Wanting to leave because you think your boss is useless or the team is tense—that's emotional. Emotional job-hopping is running away from reality, not solving the root problem.

scenes.title_en: Questions Two and Three: Resume and Advantages
scenes.context: 讲者给出后两个问题：避免盲目跳槽，跳槽前复盘自身优势。
sentences: 一年一跳或者五年三跳的履历，很难过简历初筛这一关。
A history of changing jobs yearly, or three times in five years, rarely passes resume screening.
简历初筛：resume screening
跳槽的筹码，更多来源于前几家公司积累的知识和经验。
Your leverage for job-hopping comes from the knowledge and experience you've built up.
跳槽的筹码：leverage for a move
复盘完发现优势平平，说明现在不是跳槽的好时机。
If the review shows no real edge, now is not a good time to jump.
优势平平：no real edge
paraphrase: 频繁跳槽 → 初筛即出局
Jumping too often gets you screened out immediately.
跳槽 = 用存量优势换机会
A job-hop trades your accumulated strengths for new chances.
scenes.speak: A history of changing jobs yearly, or three times in five years, rarely passes resume screening. Your leverage for job-hopping comes from the knowledge and experience you've built up. If the review shows no real edge, now is not a good time to jump.

practice: The timing isn't right for me to switch jobs.
I almost left out of emotion, not out of a real plan.
I should stay a while longer and go deeper in my current role.
Let me review what advantages I can actually take with me.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I want to change the job in March and April.
✓ 地道说法：This is the peak season, but the timing may still be wrong for me.
金三银四直译不必要，用 peak season 或直接表达时机。
✕ 直译腔：The leader is not able.
✓ 地道说法：I think my manager isn't great, but that's not a reason to leave.
「领导无能」是主观判断，英文更委婉。
✕ 直译腔：My resume is too flowery now.
✓ 地道说法：Changing jobs every year looks bad on a resume.
简历「花」是频繁更换，不是花哨。
✓ 地道说法：I should lie low, build up, and get stronger.
蛰伏用 lie low / build up 表达，不直译 hibernate。
shifts: 拨开表象，理性分析根本原因
先沉淀积累可迁移的优势
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「实际不对」按语境校正为「时机不对」，「坑挥心态」校正为「空杯心态」，「折服再沉淀」校正为「蛰伏再沉淀」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
